notes.title: Maestro version #301 - La Release Note 📜
notes.content:
**New:** Left Handed mode is here!
**New:** A DLC stand ('Downloadable Culture') has been added, to browse all the additional culture.

**Improved:** Menus Quality of Life and visual polish
**Fix:** Game audio is no longer mute when game window is not focused (PCVR)
**Fix:** Localisation issues
**Fix:** Items you brought in concert from the menu will now persist if you restart the concert.
**Fix:** Various Crashes
**Fix:** Issues while downloading DLC content

notes.title: Maestro: "SECRET SORCERY" Content Update is OUT NOW! 🔮
notes.content:
🦉5 New magical pieces: including Hedwig’s Theme from the Harry Potter series, composed and conducted by John Williams!

🌌A Sorcerous Set of cosmetics, including a Baguette Magique !

Perform in The Coven, where Secret Sorcerers gather at night, and wave your Baguette Magique to the mythical melodies of this bewitched selection!
